name: site
comment: The only file you edit. Everything else is method, not location.
Paths are project-relative; keep datasets outside the tree and symlink
them in as datasets/ (git-ignored). Runs land under runs/<arm>/.
resume_replay_root globs for the buffer rather than naming it: the mine writes
into a timestamped directory of its own, so an arm that reads it cannot know the
path in advance, and naming one would mean a symlink somebody has to make by
hand between the two runs. Name a path here if you keep several buffers around.
